papers.title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
papers.authors: Kulikov, Ilia; Whitehouse, Chenxi; Wu, Tianhao; Nie, Yixin; Saha, Swarnadeep; Helenowski, Eryk

Proposes meta-optimization of data scientist agents and a practical implementation called Agentic Self-Instruct. Tested on CS research, legal reasoning, and mathematical reasoning tasks.

papers.title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
papers.authors: Raoof, Negin; Zhuang, Richard; Nezhurina, Marianna; Guha, Etash; Tejaswi, Atula; Marten, Ryan
papers.abstract_summary: Fully open data curation pipeline for training agentic LLMs. Conducts 100+ controlled ablation experiments to investigate each stage of agentic data curation. Addresses the gap where existing open efforts target single benchmarks.

papers.title: HARP: Efficient Data Selection for Finetuning Large Language Models
papers.authors: Wang, Ning; Zhang, Zhengxin; Tang, Maosen; Gao, Yitang; Cardie, Claire; Galhotra, Sainyam
papers.abstract_summary: Proposes Hierarchical Active Region Pruning (HARP), an efficient train-based data selector that preserves downstream utility without repeated fine-tuning. Bridges gap between scalable but proxy-reliant train-free selectors and accurate but costly train-based methods.

papers.title: How Should LLMs Consume High-Quality Data? Optimal Data Scheduling via Quality-Aware Functional Scaling Laws
papers.authors: Zhu, Zhitao; Wang, Xili; Wu, Shizhe; Fu, Jiawei; Liu, Xiaoqing
papers.abstract_summary: Extends functional scaling laws with a data-quality dimension. Solves joint data-quality and batch-size scheduling in closed form. Reveals two regimes and a dual role of high-quality data: signal amplifier in noise-limited regime.

papers.title: PRISM: Preference-Aware Influence Function Based Data Selection Method for Efficient Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Lin, Qihao; Chen, Guanxu; Liu, Dongrui; Shao, Jing
papers.abstract_summary: Introduces preference-aware influence functions for data selection. Unlike existing methods that treat all target examples equally, PRISM weights target examples by relevance to model optimization. Systematic experiments across model families and scales.

papers.title: propella-1: Multi-Property Document Annotation for LLM Data Curation at Scale
papers.authors: Idahl, Maximilian; Droste, Benedikt; Plüster, Björn; Harries, Jan Philipp
papers.abstract_summary: Challenges single scalar quality scores for data curation. Introduces small multilingual LLMs (0.6B-4B) that annotate documents across 18 properties in 6 categories. Supports 57 languages. 4B model achieves higher agreement than larger general-purpose models.

papers.title: Towards Next-Generation LLM Training: From the Data-Centric Perspective
papers.authors: Liang, Hao; Zhao, Zhengyang; Han, Zhaoyang; Qiang, Meiyi; Ma, Xiaochen; Zeng, Bohan
papers.abstract_summary: Comprehensive data-centric framework for next-generation LLM training. Covers data quality evaluation, dynamic data selection conditioned on training state, and unified interface between training and data selection processes.

papers.title: DataFlex: A Unified Framework for Data-Centric Dynamic Training of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Liang, Hao; Zhao, Zhengyang; Qiang, Meiyi; Chen, Mingrui; Ma, Lu; Yu, Rongyi
papers.abstract_summary: Unified framework integrating data selection, mixture optimization, and data reweighting. Addresses fragmented codebases and inconsistent interfaces in existing approaches. Enables fair comparison and practical integration.

papers.title: Filter-then-Weight: Online Data Selection and Reweighting for LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Wang, Fangxin; Baghershahi, Peyman; He, Langzhou; Zou, Henry Peng; Medya, Sourav; Yu, Philip S.
papers.abstract_summary: Optimizer-aware framework for gradient-based online data selection and reweighting in LLM fine-tuning. Two-stage algorithm: filter geometrically useful candidates, then optimize coefficients. Views selection as shaping optimization trajectory.

papers.title: GRACE: A Dynamic Coreset Selection Framework for Large Language Model Optimization
papers.authors: Tang, Tianhao; Li, Haoyang; Chen, Lei
papers.abstract_summary: Graph-guided adaptive and dynamic coreset selection framework for LLM optimization. Addresses limitations of existing coreset methods that fail to adapt to dynamic training needs. Designed for large-scale models.

papers.title: Influence-Preserving Proxies for Gradient-Based Data Selection in LLM Fine-tuning (IPROX)
papers.authors: Chen, Sirui; Qi, Yunzhe; Ai, Mengting; Sun, Yifan; Qiu, Ruizhong; Zou, Jiaru
papers.abstract_summary: Addresses computational cost of gradient-based data selection (TracIn, Influence Functions) for multi-billion-parameter LLMs. Proposes influence-preserving proxies that maintain selection quality while reducing cost. Validated under different gradient-based influence methods.

papers.title: From Insight to Action: Interpretability-Guided Data Selection in Large Language Models (IGDS)
papers.authors: Shi, Ling; Wu, Xinwei; Zhao, Xiaohu; Wang, Hao; Liu, Heng; Liu, Yangyang
papers.abstract_summary: Bridges mechanistic interpretability and data selection. Uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to identify causal task features, then selects data based on feature activation frequency. Proposes Interpretability-Guided Data Selection (IGDS).

papers.title: On Representation Redundancy in Large-Scale Instruction Tuning Data Selection
papers.authors: Shu, Youwei; Zheng, Shaomian; Jin, Dingnan; Qu, Wenjie; Guo, Ziyao; Cui, Qing
papers.abstract_summary: Studies instruction-tuning data selection through semantic representation similarity. Identifies key limitation: LLM encoders produce highly redundant semantic embeddings. Proposes method to mitigate redundancy for industrial-scale data selection.

papers.title: UniGeM: Unifying Data Mixing and Selection via Geometric Exploration and Mining
papers.authors: Wang, Changhao; Yu, Yunfei; Yao, Xinhao; Yang, Jiaolong; Cantoro, Riccardo; Li, Chaobo
papers.abstract_summary: Unifies data mixing and selection as manifold approximation. Hierarchical: Macro-Exploration learns mixing weights via stability-based clustering; Micro-Mining filters high-quality instances by geometric distance. Achieves 2× data efficiency on 100B tokens.

papers.title: OPUS: Towards Efficient and Principled Data Selection in Large Language Model Pre-training in Every Iteration
papers.authors: Wang, Shaobo; Ouyang, Xuan; Xu, Tianyi; Hu, Yuzheng; Liu, Jialin; Chen, Guo
papers.abstract_summary: Dynamic data selection framework defining utility in optimizer-induced update space. Addresses Data Wall problem where high-quality text approaches exhaustion. Optimizer-agnostic criteria based on raw gradients replaced by optimizer-projected utility.

papers.title: Can LLMs Clean Up Your Mess? A Survey of Application-Ready Data Preparation with LLMs
papers.authors: Zhou, Wei; Zhou, Jun; Wang, Haoyu; Li, Zhenghao; He, Qikang; Han, Shaokun
papers.abstract_summary: Unified taxonomy of LLM-enhanced data preparation methods. Covers denoising, cross-dataset relationships, and valuable insight extraction. Driven by rising demands for application-ready data and increasingly powerful LLM techniques.

papers.title: A Survey on Evaluating Quality and Trustworthiness in LLM-Generated Data (LLM Data Auditor)
papers.authors: Zhang, Kaituo; Hu, Mingzhi; Le, Hoang Anh Duy; Torsha, Fariha Kabir; Jiang, Zhimeng; Bui, Minh Khai
papers.abstract_summary: Proposes LLM Data Auditor for evaluating synthetic data quality and trustworthiness. Covers quality and trustworthiness dimensions. Addresses gap where research focuses on generation methods but not evaluation.

papers.title: Provenance-Grounded Gating and Adaptive Recovery in Synthetic Post-Training Data Curation
papers.description: Controlled study of two under-explored practices in synthetic post-training filtering: (1) whether filtering signals should be grounded in source evidence that induced each generation, and (2) whether rejected samples can be systematically recovered rather than permanently discarded. Finds that exact source provenance improves faithfulness gating, hallucination and reward gates reject largely disjoint populations, and adaptive recovery combining failure diagnosis with targeted regeneration achieves higher yield than naive resampling.
papers.incremental_note: New arXiv submission, June 2026

papers.title: Rethinking Data Curation in LLM Training: Online Reweighting Offers Better Generalization than Offline Methods (ADAPT)
papers.description: Proposes rethinking data curation as an online reweighting problem rather than offline selection/mixing. Introduces ADAPT (Adaptive Data reweighting for Pretraining and FineTuning), a dynamic framework that reweights training samples with adaptive per-sample learning rates guided by similarity-based quality signals. Acts as implicit curriculum learner, shifting from coarse-grained to fine-grained distinctions. Outperforms offline selection/mixing and prior online methods on both instruction tuning and large-scale pretraining under equal FLOPs.
papers.incremental_note: Not in baseline; discovered in incremental search

papers.title: Data Value Density Enhancement for Large Language Model Training: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.description: Comprehensive survey introducing the concept of 'Data Value Density (DVD) enhancement' for LLM training. Covers methodologies for maximizing the value extracted from training data through filtering, selection, mixing ratio optimization, and quality improvement. Provides a unified framework for understanding diverse data curation techniques.
papers.incremental_note: Not in baseline; SSRN preprint discovered in incremental search

papers.title: On the Step Length Confounding in LLM Reasoning Data Selection (ASLEC)
papers.description: Identifies 'step length confounding' in naturalness-based data selection for LLM reasoning datasets: log-probability scoring systematically prefers longer reasoning steps rather than higher-quality ones. Proposes ASLEC-DROP and ASLEC-CASL mitigation methods. ACL 2026 Findings.
papers.incremental_note: ACL 2026 Findings; not in baseline. Relevant for reasoning data quality.

papers.title: InstructDiff: Domain-Adaptive Data Selection via Differential Entropy for Efficient LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.description: Uses differential entropy between base and minimally instruction-tuned models as domain-adaptive selection criterion. Reasoning tasks favor entropy increase (cognitive expansion), general tasks favor entropy decrease (cognitive compression). Achieves 17% improvement on math reasoning and 52% on general instruction-following using only 10% of data.
papers.incremental_note: January 2026 paper not in baseline; discovered in broader search sweep.

papers.title: From Insight to Action: Interpretability-Guided Data Selection in LLMs (IGDS)
papers.description: Uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to identify causal task features, then selects 'Feature-Resonant Data' that maximally activates task features for fine-tuning. Validated on math reasoning, summarization, translation with Gemma-2, LLaMA-3.1, Qwen3. Surpasses full-dataset fine-tuning by 17.4% using only 50% data. ACL 2026.
papers.incremental_note: ACL 2026; not in baseline. Novel intersection of interpretability and data selection.

papers.title: DataRater: Meta-learned Dataset Curation
papers.description: Meta-learning approach that learns which data is valuable for training rather than using hand-crafted heuristics. Scalable, fine-grained curation through learned data quality metrics. NeurIPS 2025.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025; not in baseline. Significant missed paper from original search.

papers.title: 20/20 Vision Language Models: Better VLMs through Data Curation Alone
papers.description: Demonstrates data curation alone (holding architecture, training, compute fixed) lifts VLM performance by +11.7pp across 20 benchmarks. Curated 2B model surpasses InternVL3.5-2B by 9.9pp at 17x less compute. Shows curation delivers reliability, OOD generalization, behavioral gains, and Pareto-dominance on inference cost.
papers.incremental_note: May 2026; not in baseline. Strong evidence for data curation impact on VLMs.

papers.title: MADS: Model-Aware Diverse Core Set Selection for Instruction Tuning
papers.description: Uses neural activation states during LLM inference as model-intrinsic features for diversity-based coreset selection. Core set selected by 3B model transfers to fine-tune 7B/8B/13B models. On Alpaca-GPT4 (52K pairs), 15% core set achieves 2.5% average improvement over full-dataset training. Coverage-based selection using activation features.
papers.incremental_note: May 2026 arXiv. Model-intrinsic diversity selection; cross-model transferability.

papers.title: The Long-Term Effects of Data Selection in LLM Fine-Tuning
papers.description: Introduces long-horizon view of LLM data selection across multiple fine-tuning stages. Shows short-term optimal selectors exhibit 'rank reversal' — improving current stage while slowing subsequent learning and increasing forgetting ('myopic selection'). Proposes Long-Horizon Aware Selection (LHAS) objective with coverage, future-proxy transfer, and anti-concentration terms.
papers.incremental_note: May 2026 arXiv. Novel perspective on multi-stage data selection consequences.

papers.title: DeMix: Decouple Searching from Training — Scaling Data Mixing via Model Merging for LLM Pre-training
papers.description: ICML 2026. Uses model merging to predict optimal data mixture ratios without training proxy models for every sampled mixture. Trains component models on candidate datasets, derives mixture proxies via weighted merging. Decouples search from training cost. Releases DeMix Corpora (22T-token dataset). Code: github.com/Lucius-lsr/DeMix.
papers.incremental_note: Feb 2026, accepted ICML 2026. Novel paradigm for scalable data mixture optimization.

papers.title: TBDFiltering: Sample-Efficient Tree-Based Data Filtering
papers.description: Text-embedding-based hierarchical clustering that adaptively selects documents for LLM evaluation to estimate cluster quality. Proves query efficiency: under subtree purity assumption, correctly predicts quality with O(subtree size) queries without knowing the subtree in advance. Outperforms classifier-based filtering methods experimentally. Non-parametric approach.
papers.incremental_note: Jan 2026 arXiv. Theoretically grounded, query-efficient filtering approach.

papers.title: MuRating: A High Quality Data Selecting Approach to Multilingual Large Language Model Pretraining
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025. Scalable framework that transfers high-quality English data quality signals to multilingual pretraining data selection. Addresses the challenge of quality assessment for low-resource languages where English-trained classifiers may not apply. Builds training mix for multilingual LLMs.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025. Missed by both baseline and first incremental. Critical for multilingual data curation.

papers.title: Enhancing Multilingual LLM Pretraining with Model-Based Data Selection
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025 Datasets & Benchmarks. Studies how data selection classifiers and their training datasets affect multilingual pretraining quality. Covers 20 languages with model-based filtering. Releases refined multilingual pretraining dataset.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025 D&B. Missed by both baseline and first incremental.

papers.title: NAIT: Neuron-Aware Data Selection in Instruction Tuning for Large Language Models
papers.description: Evaluates IT data impact by analyzing similarity of neuron activation patterns between IT dataset and target domain capability. Constructs reusable, transferable neuron activation features from in-domain datasets. 10% Alpaca-GPT4 subset outperforms methods using external models or uncertainty features. Reveals logical reasoning/programmatic data has strongest cross-task transferability.
papers.incremental_note: March 2026 arXiv. Novel model-intrinsic selection using neuron activation patterns.

papers.title: BRIEF: Bi-level Coreset Selection for Efficient Instruction Tuning in LLMs
papers.description: VLDB 2026. Bi-level optimization for coreset selection minimizing gradient divergence between full dataset and weighted coreset for instruction tuning. Addresses overfitting issues in LLM coreset selection. Published in PVLDB Vol 19.
papers.incremental_note: VLDB 2026. Missed by both baseline and first incremental.

papers.title: Alignment Tuning for Large Language Models: A Data-Centric Lens on Alignment Data Pipelines
papers.description: ACL 2026 Findings survey. Adopts a data-centric view of alignment data construction, treating it as an explicit pipeline rather than implicit assumption. Covers alignment data creation, filtering, and quality assessment methodologies.
papers.incremental_note: ACL 2026 Findings. Survey on alignment data curation pipelines.

papers.title: LLM Benchmark Datasets Should Be Contamination-Resistant
papers.description: ICML 2026 Position Paper. Argues benchmarks should be 'unlearnable' but support inference, leveraging asymmetry between inference and training pipelines in Transformers. Outlines mathematical frameworks for contamination resistance and calls for community adoption. Addresses benchmark leakage into pretraining corpora.
papers.incremental_note: ICML 2026 Position Paper. Relevant to benchmark decontamination in data curation.

papers.title: What Matters in Data for DPO?
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025. Systematic study of what constitutes high-impact preference data for DPO alignment. Interprets mechanisms behind widely adopted strategies and provides practical insights for constructing preference datasets.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025. Missed by both baseline and first incremental.

papers.title: The Impact of Coreset Selection on Spurious Correlations and Group Robustness
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025 D&B. Studies how data selection affects bias levels in selected coresets. Evaluates 5 data selection policies across broad range of coreset sizes for their impact on spurious correlations and group robustness.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025 D&B. Missed by both baseline and first incremental. Important fairness perspective on coreset selection.

papers.title: Less is More: Improving LLM Alignment via Preference Data Selection (BeeS)
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025. Proposes margin-maximization principle for DPO dataset curation and Bayesian Aggregation for Preference data Selection (BeeS). Studies how data filtering influences DPO training efficiency.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025. Missed by baseline and first incremental.

papers.title: Datasets, Documents, and Repetitions: The Practicalities of Unequal Data Quality
papers.description: NeurIPS 2025. Investigates practical aspects of data filtering and deduplication across multiple pre-training datasets. Studies when data filtering is justifiable and document-level mixing strategies.
papers.incremental_note: NeurIPS 2025. Missed by baseline and first incremental.

papers.title: Online Data Selection Is Implicit Alignment
papers.authors: Aoxiong Zeng, Yuxin Yang, Xiangquan Yang
papers.description: Demonstrates that online data selection during SFT acts as an implicit alignment mechanism, changing model behavioral preferences (refusal rate, verbosity, sycophancy) without any preference optimization. Formalizes online selection as reweighted SFT objective and introduces Alignment Drift Auditing (ADA) and Alignment-Aware Selection (AAS).
key_methods: online data selection as implicit alignment

papers.title: CurateEvo: Data-Curation Evolving for Agentic Post-Training
papers.authors: Dingzirui Wang, Xuanliang Zhang, Keyan Xu, Qingfu Zhu, Wanxiang Che
papers.description: Failure-driven dynamic evolution framework for agentic post-training data curation. Represents curation strategy as executable code and iteratively rewrites it using failed trajectories. Transforms raw corpus into SFT data, RL data, and inference-time memory bank. Outperforms prior curation methods on ACEBench-Agent, BFCL-V4, and τ²-Bench.

papers.title: Fidelity-Diversity Metrics for Text
papers.authors: Amanda Wang, Tudor Manole, Florentina Bunea, John Thickstun
papers.description: Develops precision/recall-inspired metrics for text dataset composition and curation. Fidelity captures how closely candidate text resembles reference data; diversity captures mode coverage. Based on optimal transport divergence functionals. Detects diversity deficits in synthetic math datasets that correlate with downstream accuracy degradation.

papers.title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models
papers.authors: Changti Wu, Bin Yu, Zhaolong Shen, Shijie Lian, Xiaopeng Lin, Cong Huang, Zhirui Zhang, Lei Zhang, Kai Chen
papers.description: Structure-aware data selection for Vision-Language-Action imitation learning. Discovers reusable visuo-motor primitives, allocates selection budgets by maximizing reuse-aware structural exposure, and selects medoid trajectories. Surpasses full-data training with only 50% demonstrations and 50% training steps.
papers.note: Focused on VLA/robotics, but structure-aware selection methodology is transferable to LLM training data

papers.title: CausalMix: Data Mixture as Causal Inference for Language Model Training
papers.authors: Zinan Tang, Yukun Zhang, Shaomian Zheng, Zhuoshi Pan, Qizhi Pei, Dingnan Jin, Jun Zhou, Yujun Wang, Biqing Huang
papers.description: Addresses data mixing under distribution shift by framing it as causal inference. Unlike proxy-model methods that assume static data distributions, CausalMix handles shifting data pools without costly retraining. Scales from small to large data pools and model sizes.
papers.note: Published July 1, 5 days before search window. Not in baseline (compiled June 29). Significant new mixing approach.

papers.title: Online Data Selection for Instruction Tuning via Gaussian Processes
papers.authors: Jun Wang, Quoc Phong Nguyen, Julien Monteil, Vu Nguyen
papers.description: Proposes GAIA (Global Adaptive Instruction tuning via GAussian processes), a framework that formulates data valuation as a global estimation process rather than batch-constrained local optimization. Overcomes limitations of existing online data selection methods.
papers.note: Published June 29, missed by baseline (compiled same day). Not in prior incremental.

papers.title: Reasoning Quality Emerges Early: Data Curation for Reasoning Models
papers.authors: Hongyi Henry Jin, Wenhan Yang, Meysam Ghaffari, Carlos Morato, Baharan Mirzasoleiman
papers.description: Shows that diverse and challenging reasoning examples can be identified early in the curation pipeline without relying on strong reasoning models. Proposes cost-effective curation for high-quality SFT data for reasoning.
papers.note: Published June 25, missed by baseline. Relevant for reasoning data curation.

papers.title: SELECting over Tokens: Curating Pre-training Data at Scale via Token Classification
papers.authors: Unknown (ACL 2026 proceedings)
papers.description: Reframes data refinement as token classification (informative vs noisy) instead of sample-level heuristic rules or costly generative approaches. Outperforms raw data by 2%+ and best heuristic baselines by 1%+ while preserving 17% more tokens. 2.5x faster than ProX-C at inference.

papers.title: Select2Reason: Efficient Instruction-Tuning Data Selection for Long-CoT Reasoning
papers.authors: Cehao Yang, Xueyuan Lin, Xiaojun Wu, Chengji (ACL 2026 Findings)
papers.description: Data selection framework for long-CoT reasoning SFT. Uses difficulty-aware reward model to estimate learning value and reasoning trace length heuristic for ranking. Fine-tuning on only 10% of selected data achieves competitive or superior performance to full-data tuning on 9 math benchmarks and 4 reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Rethinking Data Mixing from the Perspective of Large Language Models
papers.authors: Yuanjian Xu, Tianze Sun, Changwei Xu, XinLong Zhao, Jianing Hao, Ran Chen, Yang Liu, Ruijie Xu, Stephen Chen, Guang Zhang
papers.description: Establishes formal connections between gradient dynamics and domain distributions for data mixing. Introduces DoGraph, a reweighting framework that formulates data scheduling as graph-constrained optimization. Investigates what constitutes a domain and whether human/model domain perceptions align.
papers.note: arXiv preprint April 2026 (2604.07963), not in baseline. ACL 2026 Short proceedings published July.

papers.title: From Instance Selection to Fixed-Pool Data Recipe Search for Supervised Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Haodong Wu, Jiahao Zhang, Lijie Hu, Yongqi Zhang
papers.description: Reformulates SFT data selection from instance ranking to fixed-pool data recipe search, where filtering, mixing, and deduplication operators jointly shape the final data distribution through ordered curation recipes.
papers.note: Not in baseline. Discovered via ACL 2026 proceedings cross-reference. Conceptually important for data curation pipeline design.

papers.title: TiKMiX: Efficient Semi-Dynamic Data Mixture via Data Influence for LLM Pre-training
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Long Paper (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Semi-dynamic data mixing framework grounded in influence ranking invariance: relative importance of data domains exhibits strong temporal stability over long training intervals. Proposes Group Influence for quantifying domain impact and formulates mixing as periodic influence maximization. Reduces computational overhead by 80% vs REGMIX with 2% average performance gain across 9 benchmarks.

papers.title: SFTMix: Elevating Language Model Instruction Tuning with Mixup Recipe
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Long Paper (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Proposes Mixup-based recipe for instruction tuning without relying on well-curated datasets. Observes LLMs exhibit uneven confidence across semantic representation space. Interpolates examples with different confidence levels to bridge the gap: confident data prone to overfitting, unconfident data harder to generalize. Effective in both general and healthcare-specific SFT.

papers.title: SAI-DPO: Dynamic Sampling that Adapts — Self-Aware Iterative Data Persistent Optimization for Mathematical Reasoning
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Findings (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Dynamic sampling framework aligning training data with model's intrinsic competence. Introduces Knowledge Semantic Alignment for domain weaknesses and Self-Aware Difficulty (from pass rates and reasoning path characteristics). Iteratively recalibrates data distribution based on real-time feedback. Outperforms static baselines by ~6 points on 8 benchmarks including AIME24 and AMC23.

papers.title: Learning from Evolving Training Dynamics: An Entropy-Maximizing Data Curation Strategy for LLM Supervised Post-Training
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Long Paper (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Entropy-maximizing data curation strategy for SFT that adapts to evolving training dynamics. Uses training entropy signals to curate data that maximizes learning progress during supervised post-training.

papers.title: LLMSurgeon: Diagnosing Data Mixture of Large Language Models
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Long Paper (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Diagnostic tool for estimating domain-level distribution of LLM pretraining corpora. Can detect curriculum learning or staged data injection patterns from model weights alone. Provides insight into how data mixtures shape model behavior.

papers.title: Demystifying Data Organization for Enhanced LLM Training
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Long Paper (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Studies data organization strategies including curriculum learning across model scales. Analyzes score-index distributions of training data and their impact on training effectiveness. Demonstrates larger gains at higher model capacities.

papers.title: What Makes a Good Curriculum? Disentangling the Effects of Data Ordering on LLM Mathematical Reasoning
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Long Paper (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Disentangles effects of data ordering (curriculum learning) on LLM mathematical reasoning. Focuses on offline curriculum learning where data ordering is fixed prior to training. Analyzes what makes an effective curriculum for math reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Curriculum-RLAIF: Curriculum Alignment with Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Findings (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Data-centric approach to reward model generalizability via curriculum-aligned preference pair construction. Constructs preference pairs with varying difficulty levels and produces specific curriculum for reward model training.

papers.title: Calibrated Progressive Distillation: Co-Designing Curriculum and Target Mixing for Knowledge Distillation
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Findings (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Co-designs curriculum and target mixing for knowledge distillation of LLMs. Aligns with data-centric paradigms leveraging pre-training or zero-shot signals.

papers.title: EasyRL: Easy Samples Are All You Need — Self-Evolving LLMs via Data-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Findings (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Self-evolving RL framework inspired by cognitive learning theory. Uses easy labeled data for warm-up, then progressive divide-and-conquer strategy on unlabeled data with consistency-based selection and reflection-based resolution.

papers.title: Balancing Knowledge Breadth and Task Depth for Effective Domain Adaptation Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: ACL 2026 Findings (authors from anthology)
papers.description: Two-dimensional curriculum learning framework coordinating knowledge dimension and task dimension. Clusters instances by semantic similarity and annotates with task hierarchy. +2.49% medical, +1.2% financial.

papers.title: DONOD: Efficient and Generalizable Instruction Fine-Tuning for LLMs via Model-Intrinsic Data Selection
papers.authors: OpenReview (authors from forum)
papers.description: Model-intrinsic data selection framework for LLM fine-tuning efficiency. Selects high-quality data and suppresses noisy/uninformative data via dual model-intrinsic signals without relying on external models.

papers.title: DUET: Optimizing Training Data Mixtures via Feedback from Unseen Evaluation Tasks
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: Global-to-local algorithm interleaving influence function-based data selection with Bayesian optimization to optimize data mixture via feedback from unseen evaluation tasks.

papers.title: Data Mixing Can Induce Phase Transitions in Knowledge Acquisition
papers.authors: NeurIPS 2025 (from proceedings)
papers.description: Demonstrates that knowledge acquisition from knowledge-dense datasets mixed with web data can exhibit phase transitions w.r.t. mixing ratio and model size. Critical mixing ratio follows power-law relationship with model size.

papers.title: Can Generalist Agents Automate Data Curation?
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: Investigates whether generalist AI agents can automate data curation as a policy search loop. Shows that agentic data curation requires more than open-ended prompting.

papers.title: ENTP: Enhancing Low-Quality SFT Data via Neural-Symbolic Text Purge-Mix
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: Revitalizes low-quality SFT corpora through symbolic purification and neural reconstruction. ENTP-augmented datasets from low-quality data outperform 13 data-selection baselines across 5 instruction-following benchmarks.

papers.title: An Empirical Study on Influence-Based Pretraining Data Selection for Code Large Language Models
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: Explores data-influence-score filtering for programming datasets in Code-LLM pretraining. Pre-trains 1B parameter Code-LLM from scratch on 100B code tokens.

papers.title: DOSE: Data Selection for Multi-Modal LLMs via Off-the-Shelf Models
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: Uses off-the-shelf pretrained models to select training samples for larger multimodal models. Builds joint quality-alignment distribution and applies adaptive weighted sampling.

papers.title: Selection Bias in Sentiment Data of Social Media in LLM Training Datasets
papers.authors: Conference proceedings (from SearXNG DOI)
papers.description: Systematic literature review showing standard filtering pipelines (C4, RefinedWeb) systematically deplete negative sentiment content while preserving positive/neutral content.

papers.title: CCI4.0: A Bilingual Pretraining Dataset for Enhancing Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: 35TB bilingual (Chinese-English) pretraining dataset with novel quality curation pipeline: two-stage deduplication, multi-classifier quality scoring, and domain-aware fluency filtering.

papers.title: Curriculum Learning for LLM Pretraining: An Analysis of Learning Dynamics
papers.authors: arXiv (from SearXNG)
papers.description: Systematic study of data ordering in LLM pretraining under three linguistically motivated curricula.

papers.title: Neural Networks for Learnable and Scalable Influence Estimation of Instruction Fine-Tuning Data
papers.authors: NeurIPS 2025 (from proceedings)
papers.description: Uses neural networks for learnable and scalable influence estimation of instruction fine-tuning data.

papers.title: Mixtera: A Data Plane for Foundation Model Training
papers.authors: ACM (from proceedings)
papers.description: Data plane infrastructure for foundation model training that supports dynamic data mixture adjustment during training based on model's learning state.

papers.title: On the Limits of Curriculum Learning for Post-Training Large Language Models
papers.authors: OpenReview (from forum)
papers.description: Investigates limitations of curriculum learning for post-training LLMs.

papers.title: Instruction Data Selection via Answer Divergence (ADG)
papers.authors: Bo Li, Mingda Wang, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.description: Proposes Answer Divergence-Guided Selection (ADG), which selects instruction data based on the geometric structure of multi-sample outputs. Draws several high-temperature generations per instruction, maps responses into an embedding space, and computes an output divergence score that jointly encodes dispersion magnitude and shape anisotropy. Fine-tuning on only 10K ADG-selected examples consistently outperforms strong selectors on six benchmarks spanning reasoning, knowledge, and coding.

papers.title: GALA: Geometric Data Selection with Strategic Prospecting for Large Language Model Self-training
papers.authors: Zhongwei Xie, Ruihao Liao, Zimo Wang, Chong Chen, Xian-Sheng Hua, Xiao Luo
papers.description: Novel framework for LLM self-training that identifies diverse and informative samples from redundant data. Conducts clustering on latent sentence embeddings and selects anchor samples from each cluster based on geometric distance to reduce redundancy. Introduces strategic brainstorming and reflection for high-quality reasoning trajectory prospecting, plus a lightweight dynamic validation module for mini-batch quality.

papers.title: LearnAlign: Data Selection for LLM Reinforcement Learning with Improved Gradient Alignment
papers.authors: Shipeng Li, Zhiqin Yang, Shikun Li, Xiaobo Xia, Hengyu Liu, Xinghua Zhang, Gaode Chen, Dong Fang, Ying Tai, Zhe Peng
papers.description: Gradient-alignment-based method for RLVR post-training that selects learnable and representative reasoning data. Introduces data learnability based on success rate to overcome response-length bias in gradient norms. Reduces data requirements by up to 1,000 data points with better performance (77.5% vs 77.0% full-data) on GSM8K.

papers.title: Data Selection for Multi-turn Dialogue Instruction Tuning (MDS)
papers.authors: Bo Li, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
papers.description: Dialogue-level framework that scores whole conversations rather than isolated turns. Combines global coverage stage (bin-wise selection in user-query trajectory space) with local structural stage (entity-grounded topic grounding, information progress, query-answer form consistency). Outperforms strong single-turn selectors and dialogue-level LLM scorers on three multi-turn benchmarks.

papers.title: Data Mixing Agent: Learning to Re-weight Domains for Continual Pre-training
papers.authors: Kailai Yang, Xiao Liu, Lei Ji, Hao Li, et al.
papers.description: First model-based, end-to-end framework that learns to re-weight domains for continual pre-training. Uses reinforcement learning on data mixing trajectories with evaluation environment feedback. Outperforms strong baselines in achieving balanced performance across source and target field benchmarks. Generalizes well across unseen source fields, target models, and domain spaces without retraining.

papers.title: CrowdSelect: Synthetic Instruction Data Selection with Multi-LLM Wisdom
papers.authors: Yisen Li, Lingfeng Yang, Wenxuan Shen, Pan Zhou, Yao Wan, Weiwei Lin, Dongping Chen
papers.description: Investigates diverse signals for synthetic instruction data selection using Multi-LLM wisdom. Proposes three foundational metrics leveraging diverse LLM responses and reward model assessment. CrowdSelect integrates metrics with clustering-based diversity maintenance. +4.81% Arena-Hard, +11.1% MT-bench with Llama-3.2-3b-instruct.

papers.title: Aleph-Alpha-GermanWeb: Improving German-language LLM Pre-training with Model-based Data Curation and Synthetic Data Generation
papers.authors: EACL 2026 Long Paper
papers.description: German-language dataset curation pipeline combining heuristic and model-based filtering with synthetic data generation. Creates Aleph-Alpha-GermanWeb from Common Crawl, FineWeb2, and synthetic data. Shows significant performance gains over FineWeb2 alone at both 1B and 8B scales, even when FineWeb2 is enriched with Wikipedia.

papers.title: Greedy Information Projection for LLM Data Selection (GIP)
papers.authors: Victor Ye Dong et al.
papers.description: Principled framework casting data selection as maximizing mutual information between selected subset and task-specific query signals. Optimizing this score is equivalent to maximizing projection of query embedding matrix onto span of selected data, providing geometric explanation for quality-diversity co-emergence. Uses fast greedy matching-pursuit procedure. Published at 3rd DATA-FM workshop @ ICLR 2026.

papers.title: Data Mixing for Large Language Models Pretraining: A Survey and Outlook
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.description: Comprehensive survey of data mixing for LLM pretraining. Formalizes data mixture optimization as bilevel problem on probability simplex. Introduces fine-grained taxonomy: static (rule-based, learning-based) vs dynamic (adaptive, externally guided) mixing. Analyzes performance-cost trade-offs, cross-method challenges including limited transferability and unstandardized evaluation.

papers.title: Preserving LLM Capabilities through Calibration Data Curation: From Analysis to Optimization
papers.authors: NeurIPS 2025
papers.description: Studies calibration data curation for preserving critical capabilities during LLM compression. Analyzes what makes calibration data effective for different LLM capabilities and proposes a curation framework for optimizing post-training compression methods.

papers.title: Importance-aware Data Selection for Efficient LLM Instruction Tuning
papers.authors: AAAI 2026
papers.description: Proposes importance-aware metric for instruction samples to enhance LLM capabilities. Provides principled data selection strategy for efficient instruction tuning with small but high-quality datasets.

papers.title: Unifying Data, Memory, and Compute Efficiency in LLM Training: A Survey
papers.authors: IEEE
papers.description: Comprehensive survey unifying data-centric approaches (data filtering, curriculum learning, influence-based selection), memory efficiency, and compute efficiency for LLM training. Provides holistic view of efficiency dimensions.

papers.title: Data Preparation for Large Language Models
papers.authors: Springer (Journal of Computer Science and Technology)
papers.description: Comprehensive overview of data preparation methods for LLMs including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and selection. Summarizes commonly used datasets and processing techniques.

papers.title: Improving the OOD Performance of Closed-source LLMs on NLI through Strategic Data Selection
papers.authors: EACL 2026 Findings
papers.description: Investigates robustness of fine-tuned LLMs for NLI, finding in-distribution gains from fine-tuning may not generalize. Proposes strategic data selection to improve out-of-distribution performance.

papers.title: Reliability-Aware Determinantal Point Processes for Robust Informative Data Selection in Large Language Models
papers.authors: arXiv
papers.description: Addresses informative data selection using reliability-aware DPPs. Tackles the challenge of selecting informative units for both inference-time prompt construction and training-time data selection for fine-tuning or distillation.

papers.title: Understanding and Selecting Calibration Data for LLM Quantization: From Sensitivity Analysis to Activation-Based Curation
papers.authors: OpenReview
papers.description: Studies what drives calibration data sensitivity in post-training quantization of LLMs. Presents activation-based curation method for selecting effective calibration data.

papers.title: HERMES: A Multi-Granularity Labeling Substrate for Pre-training Data Mixtures
papers.authors: Ziyun Qiao, Yue Min, Ruining Chen, Yujun Li
papers.description: Proposes a hierarchical, data-derived labeling substrate for pre-training data mixtures. Uses Learned Semantic Transform followed by 3-stage residual vector quantization to annotate documents into coarse-to-fine codes (~130k cells). Demonstrates that hierarchical granularity enables data mixing interactions that fixed-granularity pipelines cannot test, achieving +0.0253 improvement on 16-task capability macro-average with combined Stage-2 rule contrast.

papers.title: Selective Left-Shift: Turning Test-Time Compute and Difficulty-based Curation into Training Data for Low-Resource Code Generation
papers.authors: Didula Samaraweera, Anjana Supun, Srinath Perera
papers.description: Proposes a three-phase pipeline for low-resource programming language code generation: (1) left-shift inference-time compute to offline data synthesis with compiler/test feedback, (2) SFT on synthetic verified data, (3) RLVR with language-agnostic I/O tests. Applied to Qwen3-8B for Julia, achieving +7.6 pass@1 on MultiPL-E using only 1/3 data and 1/6 cost of prior SOTA. Generalizes to Ballerina (49.7% MultiPL-E Pass@1).

papers.title: Brevity is the Soul of Inference Efficiency: Inducing Concision in VLMs via Data Curation
papers.authors: DatologyAI: Matthew L. Leavitt, Siddharth Joshi, Haoli Yin, et al.
papers.description: Argues that brevity is the missing inference-efficiency lever and that pretraining data curation can make VLMs answer in fewer tokens (lower Cost-of-Pass). Applied to MAmmoTH-VL, achieves 35x Cost-of-Pass advantage over Qwen3.5-4B within ~1pp accuracy. Shows that generic verbosity buys no accuracy at any capability level, and that curation for concision concedes no quality.
papers.note: Recovered - missed in Jun 24-Jul 10 runs, DatologyAI (v2 update Jun 29)

papers.title: Data Selection Through Iterative Self-Filtering for Vision-Language Settings
papers.authors: Andrei Liviu Nicolicioiu, Sarvjeet Singh Ghotra, Morgane M. Moss, Aaron Courville
papers.description: Proposes a bootstrapped self-filtering method where a CLIP model is trained on an evolving, self-selected dataset. The method iterates between training and selecting a subsequently improved data mixture, balancing filtered clean samples with diverse samples from the full distribution. Improves downstream performance without additional data or pre-trained models.

papers.title: Spokes: Optimizing for Diverse Pretraining Data Selection
papers.description: Addresses diversity in pretraining data selection to reduce redundancy and repetition under fixed data budgets. Proposes methods for optimizing diverse data selection to improve model performance.

papers.title: Characterizing Narrative Content in Web-scale LLM Pretraining Data
papers.authors: Teagan Johnson, Elliott Ash, Andrew Piper, Maria Antoniak
papers.description: First fine-grained study of narrative features in Dolma (3T-token open pretraining corpus). Designs framework spanning 3 narrative elements (agency, setting, events) operationalized as 11 interpretable dimensions. Finetunes NarraBERT for narrative prediction, applies to 3M passages to create NarraDolma dataset. Finds narrative structure is measurable at scale, unequally distributed across sources, and current curation practices neither measure nor account for narrative qualities.
papers.note: Recovered - missed in Jun 17-Jul 10 runs, provides new lens for data quality assessment

papers.title: When T2I Synthetic Data Backfires: Amplified Privacy Risks in Real-Synthetic Mix Training
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Reveals that Real-Synthetic Mix-Training (RSMT) with T2I-generated data can substantially amplify privacy leakage of real training samples. Proposes RSMT Memorization Amplification theory proving synthetic data displaces real samples toward peripheral feature space regions, forcing more aggressive memorization. Introduces RSMixLeak membership inference attack framework and a lightweight leakage propensity indicator.

papers.title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Studies LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts whose model scores and rankings approximate the full benchmark suite. Uses submodular subset selection (DPP, submodular mutual information, facility location) operating on semantic prompt embeddings without model evaluation outcomes. On 35 heterogeneous benchmarks with 18 frontier LLMs and 61K+ prompts, facility location function preserves scores better than 12 baselines.

papers.title: Holistic Data Scheduler (HDS): Online Data Mixing via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Formulates online data mixing as a reinforcement learning problem in continuous control space using Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Introduces multi-objective holistic reward integrating data-driven quality, loss-driven inter-domain influence, and model-driven weight norm rewards. Reaches final validation perplexity of next-best method with 44% fewer training iterations on The Pile. 7.2% MMLU improvement.
papers.recovery_note: Published June 23, missed by all prior searches. High-value online mixing approach.

papers.title: Learning at the Right Pace: Adaptive Data Scheduling Improves LLM Reinforcement Learning (ADS)
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Proposes Adaptive Data Scheduling (ADS), a dual-level framework replacing uniform sampling with adaptive distribution over semantic clusters and policy-boundary sample selection for RL post-training. Cluster level maintains adaptive inter-cluster distribution; sample level selects policy-boundary samples for informative advantages. Improves GRPO average accuracy by 5.2% across 3 LLMs and 7 reasoning benchmarks. Code: github.com/Richard-zrx/ADS.
papers.recovery_note: Published June 21. Critical paper for RL post-training data scheduling.

papers.title: Less is More: Quality-Aware Training Data Selection for Scientific Summarization
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Constructs one of the largest biomedical long-document summarization datasets (1.88M PMC articles). Shows author-written abstracts vary in alignment with source articles, and quality signals can guide training data selection. High-quality subsets outperform random sampling at matched sizes and match/exceed larger random subsets on factuality metrics.

papers.title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Can Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Challenges the view that RLVR only reallocates sampling among existing trajectories. Proposes boundary-aware Curriculum RL: locates reasoning capacity boundary via pass@k, applies teacher guidance to boundary examples, then RL to consolidate new patterns. Improves pass@256 by 9.8pp over base models and 10.3pp over Vanilla RLVR across Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek.

papers.title: Unified Data Selection for LLM Reasoning (HES: High-Entropy Sum)
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Proposes High-Entropy Sum (HES), a training-free metric summing only top 0.5% highest-entropy tokens per reasoning sample. Validated across SFT, RFT, and RL paradigms. In SFT, top 20% HES-ranked data matches full-dataset performance. In RL, HES-selected trajectories significantly surpass other methods. Establishes HES as a robust unified metric for reasoning data selection.

papers.title: GRACE: Gradient-aligned Reasoning Data Curation for Efficient Post-training
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Views each reasoning trace as a sequence of optimization events, scoring every step by alignment with answer-oriented gradient direction and consistency with preceding trajectory. Introduces representation-level gradient proxy for step-level alignment in single forward pass. GRACE reaches 108.8% of full-data performance with 20% data and retains 100.2% with only 5%.

papers.title: SHIFT: Single-Rollout Hidden-State Dynamics for Training-Free RLVR Data Selection
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Studies RLVR data selection before any RL training, without labels or reward evaluation on the full pool. Proposes SHIFT: one-shot training-free selector based on inference-time hidden-state dynamics. Computes Reasoning-Induced Representation Shift (RIRS) as start-to-end hidden-state delta. Uses quality-weighted farthest-first CoreSet in RIRS-augmented space. Code: github.com/JianghaoWu/SHIFT.

papers.title: IRDS: Interpretable RLVR Data Selection via Verifier-Coupled Sparse Autoencoder Coverage
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Selects RLVR training instances on SAE cluster basis for auditable selection. Introduces verifier-coupled coverage objective on SAE basis, solved by greedy log-determinant maximization. Achieves highest overall accuracy: +3.9/+4.0pp on Qwen models and +0.5pp on Llama-3.1-8B vs strongest baseline, at 10× lower cost than trajectory-based methods.

papers.title: D³: Dynamic Directional Graph-Constrained Data Scheduling for LLM Training
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Formulates data sample interactions as a dynamic influence graph where edges represent loss-based dependencies. Solves constrained optimization over the graph to derive training order respecting evolving information flow. Theoretically motivated with efficient approximation algorithm. Code: github.com/xuyj233/D3.

papers.title: SLAP: Stratified Loss-based Pruning for On-Policy Data-Efficient Instruction Tuning
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Batch-aware data selection framework evaluating learnability of entire batch compositions. Ensures distribution coverage via stratified sampling while maximizing intra-batch diversity through relative distance optimization. Uses Hessian-approximated gradient information. Outperforms SOTA across LLaMA and ChatGLM with 20-40% less data.

papers.title: Learning-Zone Energy (LZE): Online Data Selection for Efficient RL Post-Training
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Defines closed-form Learning-Zone Energy Score fusing initial-difficulty anchor, normalized outcome-uncertainty, and pass-rate momentum into single scalar provably aligned with expected group-relative policy gradient magnitude. Forward pruner with replay skips rollouts for solved prompts. Retains 40% data per step, matches/surpasses full-data baselines. +45.9% AIME25, +18.2% AMC23, 36% FLOPs reduction. Code: github.com/Stellaris167/LZE.

papers.title: Beyond What to Select: Plug-and-play Oscillatory Data-Volume Scheduling (PODS)
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Revisits data selection from optimization perspective, showing selected-data training induces implicit regularization modulated by selection ratio. Proposes PODS: dynamically schedules how much data to select (not which samples), alternating between low-ratio regularization and high-ratio recovery phases. Reduces ImageNet-1k training cost by 50% with improved accuracy; accelerates LLM instruction tuning by 2× without degradation.

papers.title: Data Attribution in Large Language Models via Bidirectional Gradient Optimization
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Expands inverse formulation of training data attribution: how would training data be affected if model had seen generated output during training? Perturbs base model via bidirectional gradient optimization (ascent and descent) on generated text, measures loss change across training samples. Supports arbitrary data granularity for factual and stylistic attribution.

papers.title: On the Difficulty of Learning a Meta-network for Training Data Selection (MTS Analysis)
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Identifies two obstacles in Meta-learning for Training-data Selection (MTS): poor gradient signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR) causing optimization difficulties, and lack of informative features correlating with data quality. Mathematical analysis reveals normalized data weight dynamics and relation between disparate data quality and poor GSNR. Proposes increasing batch size as solution. Proposes informative features capturing distribution positions and training dynamics. Average 5.49% improvement.

papers.title: GIST: Targeted Data Selection for Instruction Tuning via Coupled Optimization Geometry
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Shows axis-aligned optimizer statistics break down in PEFT methods like LoRA where optimization geometry exhibits strong cross-parameter coupling. Proposes GIST (Gradient Isometric Subspace Transformation): recovers task-specific subspace from validation gradients via SVD, projects training gradients into coupled subspace, scores by alignment with target directions. Matches SOTA with 0.29% storage and 25% compute.

papers.title: Bilevel Data Curation for LLM Fine-tuning: Offline Selection and Online Self-Refining Generation
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Develops unified bilevel framework combining offline data selection with online self-refining generation. Bilevel data selection (BDS) theoretically shown to outperform direct data mixing in useful data coverage. Provides global convergence analysis for gradient-based BDS for one-layer Transformer. Introduces bilevel multi-objective optimization (BMO) for response-level weighting with closed-form importance-ratio weight.

papers.title: What Makes Good Instruction-Tuning Data? An In-Context Learning Perspective (wICI)
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Proposes weighted in-context influence (wICI) framework measuring how effectively each candidate reduces instruction-following difficulty for semantically related peers. Addresses what constitutes effective IT data from in-context perspective, whether sample difficulty correlates with in-context influence, and how in-context influence translates to IT effectiveness. Outperforms baselines under constrained budgets.

papers.title: Scaling Multi-Hop Training Data via Graph-Constrained Path Selection
papers.authors: Unknown (see arXiv)
papers.abstract: Decouples multi-hop data construction: reasoning paths enumerated offline over graph of contextual keyword centroids, teacher invoked only to verbalize pre-validated paths. Graph enforces five geometric admissibility constraints. At equal training scale, constrained/unconstrained chains yield indistinguishable performance; gain at full scale comes from 4.4× expansion of usable corpus. Fine-tuning Qwen3-32B on 80K legal contract examples improves Token F1 from 21.66% to 38.58%. Code: github.com/hkgai-official/GCSCS.

tools_and_repos.name: DataTrove (HuggingFace)
tools_and_repos.description: Library to process, filter and deduplicate text data at very large scale. Provides prebuilt blocks for LLM training data pipelines. Supports local, slurm, and Ray execution. Includes MinHash dedup, sentence dedup, exact substring dedup, and various filters.

tools_and_repos.name: DCLM (DataComp-LM)
tools_and_repos.description: Benchmark and baseline for pretraining data filtering strategies. Provides a testbed for comparing data curation methods on language model performance.

tools_and_repos.name: RedPajama
tools_and_repos.description: Open-source reproduction of LLaMA training data with detailed filtering and deduplication pipeline documentation.

tools_and_repos.name: SlimPajama
tools_and_repos.description: 627B token cleaned and deduplicated version of RedPajama with extensive filtering. Includes MinHash dedup and quality filtering.

tools_and_repos.name: DataComp
tools_and_repos.description: Benchmark for comparing data filtering/selection strategies for vision-language models. Standardized testbed for CLIP-like model data curation.

tools_and_repos.name: dolma (OLMo)
tools_and_repos.description: Data processing toolkit used for OLMo. Includes deduplication, filtering, and quality scoring tools for pretraining data.

tools_and_repos.name: data-prep-kit (IBM)
tools_and_repos.description: IBM's data preparation toolkit for LLM training. Provides modular transforms for text processing, filtering, and deduplication.

tools_and_repos.name: fineWeb (HuggingFace)
tools_and_repos.description: 15T token web dataset with documented DataTrove filtering pipeline. Includes deduplication and quality filtering best practices.

tools_and_repos.name: deduplicate-text-datasets (Google Research)
tools_and_repos.description: Google's tool for exact substring deduplication at scale. Uses suffix arrays for efficient duplicate detection.

tools_and_repos.name: Coresetlib
tools_and_repos.description: Library implementing various coreset selection methods for deep learning including gradient matching, facility location, and influence-based methods.

tools_and_repos.title: CuratorKIT - Post-Training Data Curation Library
tools_and_repos.description: Open-source Python library for building auditable post-training data curation pipelines. Covers full lifecycle: ingestion (6 format readers), pre-generation filtering, synthetic data generation, quality filtering, and provenance tracking. Single configurable framework replacing fragmented toolchains. Released alongside the paper.
tools_and_repos.incremental_note: New tool, June 2026. GitHub repo not yet indexed by search engines at time of search.

tools_and_repos.title: DeMix Corpora and Code
tools_and_repos.description: Code and 22T-token dataset released with the DeMix paper (ICML 2026). Implements model-merging-based data mixture optimization. Includes component model training scripts and mixture evaluation tools.
tools_and_repos.incremental_note: Released with DeMix paper, Feb 2026. GitHub repo for data mixture optimization.

tools_and_repos.name: ptbr-cpt-data-ablation
tools_and_repos.description: Controlled data-curation ablation study examining deduplication and quality/repetition filtering for continued pre-training of a small Portuguese LLM. Provides empirical evidence on the impact of different curation strategies.

tools_and_repos.name: CuratorKIT (Lexsi-Labs)
tools_and_repos.description: Open-source implementation of CuratorKIT for data curation and synthetic data generation for LLM post-training. Companion code to the CuratorKIT paper.
tools_and_repos.note: Paper (CuratorKIT) already in baseline. GitHub repo discovered in this run. 23 stars, actively maintained (last update July 8).

tools_and_repos.name: BLISS-Bilevel-Data-Selection
tools_and_repos.description: ICML 2026 accepted paper: BLISS - A Lightweight Bilevel Influence Scoring Method for Data Selection in Language Model Pretraining. Code implementation for scalable bilevel influence scoring.
tools_and_repos.comparison: New ICML 2026 code release. Complements existing influence-based methods (TracIn, IF-GUIDE) with bilevel optimization perspective.

tools_and_repos.name: ADS (Adaptive Data Scheduling)
tools_and_repos.description: Code for 'Learning at the Right Pace: Adaptive Data Scheduling Improves LLM Reinforcement Learning'. Dual-level data scheduling for RL post-training with semantic cluster-based pacing.
tools_and_repos.comparison: New repo for RL post-training data scheduling. Complements LZE and GRPO-based approaches.

tools_and_repos.name: SHIFT (Training-Free RLVR Data Selection)
tools_and_repos.description: Code for SHIFT: one-shot training-free RLVR data selector based on inference-time hidden-state dynamics. Reasoning-Induced Representation Shift (RIRS) with quality-weighted CoreSet.
tools_and_repos.comparison: Novel training-free approach for RLVR data selection. Complements training-based methods like LZE and IRDS.

tools_and_repos.name: D3 (Dynamic Directional Data Scheduling)
tools_and_repos.description: Code for D³: Dynamic Directional Graph-Constrained Data Scheduling for LLM Training. Formulates data interactions as dynamic influence graph.
tools_and_repos.comparison: Graph-based scheduling approach distinct from linear curriculum methods. Complements HDS and PODS.

tools_and_repos.name: LZE (Learning-Zone Energy)
tools_and_repos.description: Code for Learning-Zone Energy: online data selection for RL post-training. Closed-form energy score with forward pruner and replay.
tools_and_repos.comparison: Online RL data selection with theoretical grounding. 36% FLOPs reduction with matched/exceeded performance.

tools_and_repos.name: GCSCS (Graph-Constrained Multi-Hop Data)
tools_and_repos.description: Code for scaling multi-hop training data via graph-constrained path selection. 4.4× corpus expansion through geometric constraints.
tools_and_repos.comparison: Novel graph-based approach for multi-hop data construction at scale.

tools_and_repos.name: Smart-data-selection-for-language-modeling
tools_and_repos.description: Training TinyLlama-1.1B with hierarchical clustering-based filtering inspired by Rho-1. Uses token representations from reference model for data selection.
tools_and_repos.comparison: Small research repo exploring clustering-based filtering. Updated July 9.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: FineWeb: A Comprehensive Framework for High-Quality Web Data Processing
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Detailed walkthrough of building a 15T token web dataset using DataTrove, covering filtering strategies, deduplication approaches, and quality metrics.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: The DataComp-LM Benchmark for Data Filtering
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Overview of the DCLM benchmark for systematically comparing data filtering strategies for language models.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: SmolLM Technical Report: Data Curation for Small Language Models
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: Documents data curation and filtering strategies used to build high-quality small language models from limited data budgets.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Spend 80% of Your LLM Compute on Data, Not Training
blog_posts_and_tutorials.author: Max Idahl
blog_posts_and_tutorials.summary: Argues data investments exhibit durability that training investments lack. A curated dataset from 2024 can train models across years. Advocates shifting compute allocation from training to data curation for better long-term ROI.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Why Data Curation Became the Bottleneck Again
blog_posts_and_tutorials.author: Pebblous AI
blog_posts_and_tutorials.summary: Analysis of why data curation is now the primary bottleneck in foundation model development. Cites FineWeb-Edu results: 38B curated tokens match 350B unfiltered (9× efficiency). Phi's 1.3B model beats GPT-3.5. Argues data curation, not model size, determines performance.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Scaling Pedagogical Pre-training: From Optimal Mixing to 10 Billion Tokens
blog_posts_and_tutorials.author: Asankhaya Sharma (codelion)
blog_posts_and_tutorials.summary: Documents DatologyAI's UberWeb project showing targeted per-language curation of 20T-token corpus enables 3B/8B models to match baselines at 4-10× lower compute. Discusses pedagogical pre-training strategies and optimal data mixing approaches.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Reproducible Data Curation In The Multimodal Lakehouse
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: LanceDB blog on turning raw multimodal data into reproducible, training-ready datasets. Covers search, filtering, deduplication, sampling, and versioned curation workflows. Practical tooling perspective for multimodal data pipelines.
blog_posts_and_tutorials.incremental_note: LanceDB blog on reproducible curation workflows for multimodal data.

blog_posts_and_tutorials.title: Data for Agents (NVIDIA / HuggingFace Blog)
blog_posts_and_tutorials.description: NVIDIA blog post discussing open data curation strategies for agentic AI. Covers Nemotron Post-Training v3 Prompt Atlas (interactive visual map for exploring post-training data mixture), synthetic data generation for agent training, data quality considerations for multilingual agents, and the Nemotron-Personas framework for culturally grounded synthetic data. Published July 8, slightly outside the strict July 10-11 window but relevant as context.
